configurationRule.description: Allow non-browser readers on fixed read-only Olympus feed endpoints
configurationRule.expression: (http.host eq "jacob-neel.com" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.path in {"/api/olympus" "/api/olympus/" "/api/olympus/v1" "/api/olympus/v1/cluster" "/api/olympus/v1/schema.json" "/api/olympus/v1/types.ts" "/api/olympus/v1/integration"})
